question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH customer_period_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01' THEN 'January–June 2025' ELSE 'July–December 2025' END AS REPORTING_PERIOD,
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
    AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
    AND CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  REPORTING_PERIOD,
  COUNT_IF(ORDER_COUNT >= 2) AS REPEAT_CUSTOMER_COUNT
FROM customer_period_orders
GROUP BY REPORTING_PERIOD
ORDER BY REPORTING_PERIOD

action.answer: Counting distinct customers with at least two recorded orders within each half-year (repeat status evaluated separately per period): January–June 2025 had 95,048 repeat customers; July–December 2025 had 96,514. July–December had 1,466 more repeat customers.
